text: make a website for my friend's south indian restaurant called Kaveri Kitchen in Pune. people should be able to see the menu with prices, filter it by veg and non-veg, see today's specials, book a table on whatsapp, find the address and opening hours, see photos of the dishes, and read a few customer reviews. it should feel warm and homely and work well on phones

@Requester I need a few details from you before we start. I won't make any of these up.
Please send these: What are the full address, the opening hours (including any closed day) and the WhatsApp number for table bookings; Please send the menu: each dish name, its price in rupees, and whether it is veg or non-veg. Do you have it all now; Please send today's specials (dish and price). Do you want them to be easy to change later; Please send 3 or more customer reviews (name and what they said) and the dish photos or links to them. If you don't have some of these yet, say which..
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

WhatsApp for bookings: +91 00000 33333. Restaurant phone: +91 00000 44444. Address: 7 Karve Road, Kothrud, Pune 411038. Hours: 8am to 10:30pm every day, kitchen closes 10pm. Menu with prices: Starters: Medu vada 120, Veg cutlet 140, Chicken 65 260. Mains: Masala dosa 160, Mysore dosa 180, Idli sambar 110, Veg thali 280, Chicken chettinad 340, Fish curry meal 360. Desserts: Payasam 100, Filter coffee 60. Veg items: all except Chicken 65, Chicken chettinad, Fish curry meal. Today's specials: Mysore dosa and Fish curry meal. Reviews: "Best dosa in Kothrud" - Anita R.; "Feels like home" - Vikram S.; "Great filter coffee" - Neha P. Booking: tables for 1 to 8 people, book by WhatsApp with name, date, time and number of people. Nothing is on offer or discounted right now. Pictures: no photos yet, show empty photo spots.

@Requester Thanks, I have everything I need. The team will now build the Kaveri Kitchen site with your menu, specials, WhatsApp booking, hours, reviews and empty photo spots. I'll tell you when it's ready.

@Adaptation Charter is recorded. Propose the workflows for the Kaveri Kitchen site from the done-when list. Use only the facts in the charter and never invent content. Photos are empty placeholder spots by the Requester's choice.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 12 checkable done-when items. Work can start.
@Priority Seven small workflows cover all 12 done-when items. Total is 120 on the rate card, with nothing left out. Menu data sits in one editable object that the filter and specials both read.

proposal.name: Page shell, warm styling, no-offer wording
proposal.goal_gap: No page exists yet: no layout, colours, navigation or nav anchors.
proposal.expected_outcome: A single HTML file with a warm, homely mobile-first theme (earthy colours, friendly wording), a nav whose links all point to existing section ids, and no offer, discount or deal wording. No horizontal overflow at 360px or 1280px.
proposal.completion_check: No JS errors on load; no horizontal scroll at 360px and 1280px; every in-page link targets an existing id; text search finds none of: offer, discount, deal, % off.

proposal.name: Name, address, contacts and opening hours
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot find who and where the restaurant is, or when it is open and how to call.
proposal.expected_outcome: Header and contact section showing Kaveri Kitchen, 7 Karve Road, Kothrud, Pune 411038, WhatsApp +91 00000 33333, tap-to-call tel link for +91 00000 44444, hours 8am to 10:30pm every day with the note that the kitchen closes at 10pm.
proposal.completion_check: Page text contains the name, full address, both numbers and the hours with the 10pm kitchen note; the phone number is an a[href^='tel:'] link.

proposal.name: Priced menu with veg and non-veg filter
proposal.goal_gap: No menu, no prices, no filter.
proposal.expected_outcome: A single JS menu data object (name, price, category, veg flag, special flag) rendering 11 dishes under Starters, Mains and Desserts with rupee prices, a veg or non-veg mark on each, and an All / Veg / Non-veg filter. Non-veg is Chicken 65, Chicken chettinad and Fish curry meal.
proposal.completion_check: All shows 11 dishes with the stated prices; Veg shows 8 and hides the three non-veg dishes; Non-veg shows exactly those three; every dish carries a veg or non-veg mark.

proposal.name: Today's specials from menu data
proposal.expected_outcome: A Today's specials section built from the menu data's special flag: Mysore dosa and Fish curry meal with their menu prices (180 and 360).
proposal.completion_check: Section lists exactly Mysore dosa at 180 and Fish curry meal at 360, read from the menu data; changing the special flag changes the section.

proposal.name: WhatsApp table booking form
proposal.expected_outcome: A form with name, date, time and number of people (1 to 8) that opens a wa.me chat to 910000033333 with a pre-filled, URL-encoded message of those details.
proposal.completion_check: Submitting valid input opens a wa.me/910000033333 URL whose text contains name, date, time and party size; people outside 1 to 8 or empty fields are blocked.

proposal.name: Dish photo placeholders
proposal.goal_gap: No dish photos section, and no real photos exist yet.
proposal.expected_outcome: A Dish photos section with clearly marked empty photo spots (labelled 'Photo coming soon'), easy to swap for real images later.
proposal.completion_check: Section has at least 3 visibly labelled empty spots, no fake images, and no overflow at 360px.

proposal.name: Customer reviews
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot read what customers say.
proposal.expected_outcome: A reviews section with exactly three supplied reviews: "Best dosa in Kothrud" - Anita R., "Feels like home" - Vikram S., "Great filter coffee" - Neha P.
proposal.completion_check: Section shows those three quotes with their names and no other reviews, ratings or invented text.
